items.name: Mideni Trade (IA Trader)
items.description: An autonomous crypto-trading platform with a live control-center dashboard: Binance market data, indicators, a signal scanner, and a real-time event feed. M1 (data pipeline + dashboard) is complete; the decision committee and risk/execution engine land in M2, followed by ML and backtesting.

items.name: Mo7amy
items.description: A lawyer marketplace for Tunisia: search verified lawyers by specialty and governorate, then book a consultation in person, by video, or by phone. Lawyers define weekly availability rules that are materialised into concrete bookable slots, and booking runs a race-safe hold-then-confirm flow settled by a single atomic update. The marketplace loop is in place; an AI assistant over Atlas vector search is scoped next.
